text: CREATE TABLE users (id SERIAL PRIMARY KEY, name VARCHAR(100));
CREATE INDEX idx_users_email ON users(email) WHERE email IS NOT NULL;
SELECT name, salary, AVG(salary) OVER (PARTITION BY department) FROM employees;
SELECT data->>'name' as name FROM users WHERE data @> '{"active": true}';

INSERT INTO counters (name, hits)
VALUES ('home', 1)
ON CONFLICT (name)
DO UPDATE SET hits = counters.hits + 1;

WITH RECURSIVE tree AS (
  SELECT id, parent_id, name FROM categories WHERE parent_id IS NULL
  UNION ALL
  SELECT c.id, c.parent_id, c.name
  FROM categories c JOIN tree t ON c.parent_id = t.id
)
SELECT * FROM tree;

SELECT id, name
FROM users
ORDER BY created_at DESC
LIMIT 5;

SELECT * FROM products
WHERE name ILIKE '%phone%';

SELECT * FROM events
WHERE created_at > NOW() - INTERVAL '7 days';

SELECT d::date
FROM generate_series('2026-01-01'::date, '2026-01-31'::date, '1 day') AS d;

SELECT u.name, o.total
FROM users u
CROSS JOIN LATERAL (
  SELECT total FROM orders
  WHERE user_id = u.id
  ORDER BY created_at DESC LIMIT 1
) o;

CREATE INDEX idx_docs_tags ON docs USING GIN (tags);
CREATE INDEX idx_profiles_data ON profiles USING GIN (data jsonb_path_ops);
